equipment.name: 4pt Sheet Resistance
equipment.specifications: The co-linear four point probe system measures sheet resistance values from 0.1 milli-ohm per square up to 99 kilo-ohm per square. Thin films on samples less than 3” in diameter can be used with the system. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Accent Hall Effect Measurement
equipment.specifications: The Accent hall effect tool is a turn-key system for measurement of resistivity, carrier concentration and mobility semiconductor materials. Samples can have Van der Pauw, bar, or bridge shaped geometries can all be used. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Acid Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: The general purpose wet bench handles a majority of required aqueous chemistries within the cleanroom. Small pieces through 8” wafers can be accommodated using various provided PTFE holders. No solvents or heavy metals. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: AJA RF/DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: The AJA Orion system is capable of both RF and DC based magnetron sputtering in a high vacuum turbo pumped chamber. Four targets are installed concurrently and can enable co-sputtering. 3” samples can be heated, via an IR lamp, up to 600C. No toxics. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Allied High Tech Polish/Grind/Lap
equipment.specifications: The Allied MultiPrep system enables precise semiautomatic sample preparation of a wide range of materials for microscopic evaluation. Capabilities include parallel polishing, angle polishing, site-specific polishing or any combination thereof. Samples up to 3” can be mounted onto the platen assembly and polished with diamond embedded film and/or slurries. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Applied Materials P5000 PECVD
equipment.specifications: The Applied Materials P5000 has two dedicated chambers for dielectric PECVD. One utilizes a TEOS/O2 chemistry for silicon dioxide and the other is SiH4/NH3 capable for silicon nitrides. Both can process up to 8” wafers and deposit films multiple microns thick. Nominal operating temperature is ~400C. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Atomic Force Microscope
equipment.specifications: Digital Instruments Multimode IIIa Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) can obtain 3D surface topography at nanometer scale resolution, to measure contact and friction forces between surfaces. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Auger Electron Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: Provides detailed surface chemistry at the sub-10 nm scale. Operates by spectroscopy of Auger electrons generated by an ultra-fine scanning electron probe. Chemical information from regions as small as 10 nm with sensitivity of a few parts per thousand. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Bruce Horizontal Furnace
equipment.specifications: High temperature, three tube, atmospheric, horizontal furnace. Accepts up to 5” wafers with maximum operating temperature of 1100C. Tube 1: CMOS compatible dry oxidations. Tube 2: dry oxidations, wet oxidation, inert anneals. Tube 3: solid source phosphorus doping. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Bruker Optical Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Non-contact method to study sample surface topography in three dimensions. Vertical resolution on the order of ten of nanometers with a trade off in field size. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss 1540EsB Crossbeam
equipment.specifications: FIB/SEM system with FESEM electron column (resolution approaching 2nm) and Ga ion column for milling. Can deposit Pt, W, and SiOx via GIS. GIS has 2 etch gases (XeF2 and H2O). Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss Supra 55 FESEM
equipment.specifications: FESEM with Schottky thermal field emission source. Imaging resolution in the 2nm range. Multiple detectors for Secondary Imaging and Backscatter. Equipped with blanker and control system for electron beam lithography. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Confocal Raman Microscope
equipment.specifications: WITec Alpha 300R Confocal Raman imaging system. Acquires chemical information non-destructively with ~200 nm resolution. Equipped with 532 nm green laser, max 17 mW power. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: CorSolutions Microfluidic Station
equipment.specifications: Probe station for non-permanent, compression connections to microfluidic devices. High precision, programmable pumps deliver constant controlled flows or biomimetic modulations. Includes microscope and video capture system. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: CVC DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: Cryo pumped high vacuum system for PVD sputtering of conductive targets. Up to 8” substrates can be processed; four targets concurrently installed. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Dektak 6 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Semi-manual contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Dektak 8 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth. Scan lengths up to 50mm on samples as large as 8” wafers. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Denton Pt Sputter System
equipment.specifications: Tabletop sputter coater used for SEM sample preparation. Platinum target for depositing thin conductive film. Maximum sample size ~2”. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Despatch Convection Oven
equipment.specifications: High uniformity convection oven used for resist post bakes. Operating temp typically 120C, capable up to ~200C. Atmospheric pressure in room air. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Developing Bench
equipment.specifications: Used to dissolve non-cross linked polymeric films (photoresist). Submersion based development for samples up to 8” in diameter. Aqueous hydroxide based develop solutions only. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Dual Beam SEM and FIB
equipment.specifications: VERSA 3D Dual Beam combining scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB) in a single platform. Samples can be ion beam milled and platinum deposited. Secondary and backscattered electron imaging available. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Edwards Thermal Evaporator
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped system for thin film deposition with two power sources capable of binary sequential or co-evaporative process. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Electrostatic manipulator
equipment.specifications: Electrostatic manipulator used to lift-out TEM samples and move micron sized flakes/particles into positions of interest. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Filmetrics F40 Interferometer
equipment.specifications: Provides rapid thin film thickness and optical constants measurements on common device film stacks. 30um spot size, samples up to 8” wafers. Transparent films from ~50nm to tens of microns. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: FineTech Die Bonder
equipment.specifications: Fineplacer system multipurpose bonder with ~5um placement accuracy for flip chip bonding, die bonding, and micro-assembly. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Flood UV Exposure / Ozone Clean
equipment.specifications: UV flood exposure system utilizing ozone and oxygen radical species to clean organics or modify surfaces. Samples up to 6” in diameter. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: Perkin Elmer Spectrum One FT-IR Spectrometer operating in range 4000 - 350 cm-1 with 0.5 cm-1 resolution. Equipped with mid-range DTGS infrared detector. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Headway Manual Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: Spin coats liquid materials, solutions, or suspensions. Spindle manually controlled up to 4” substrates. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Headway Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: Uses centrifugal force to coat fluids across substrate surface. Small pieces through 6” wafers. Programmable controller, speeds up to 8000RPM (typo in source: 800RPM). Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Heatpulse Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA processing up to 4” wafers. Atmospheres: N2, Ar, O2. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: High Temp 1” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: High temperature convective tube furnace processing up to 0.5” samples. Atmospheres: Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to >1400C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: JA Woollam Ellipsometer
equipment.specifications: Non-contact measurement system for thickness and optical properties of thin films. Samples over 44 discrete wavelengths across white light spectrum. Measures films from ~1um to single nanometers. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Jipelec Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA tool processing up to 6” wafers. Atmospheres: Ar, Ar/H2, ethylene. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Ball Bonder
equipment.specifications: K&S 4524 Ball Bonder with digital controls for ultrasonically bonding gold wires from 18 - 75 micron. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Wedge Bonder
equipment.specifications: Manual wedge wire bonder configured for gold or aluminum wire sizes from 0.7 to 3.0 mil. Includes heated work holder and stereo-zoom microscope. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (1)
equipment.specifications: Modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer for current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior analysis. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (2)
equipment.specifications: Modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer for current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior analysis. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 2” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: Convective tube furnace processing up to 1.5” samples. Atmospheres: N2, Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 3” Metal Furnace
equipment.specifications: Convective tube furnace processing up to 2.5” samples. Atmospheres: Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to >1200C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Microtome
equipment.specifications: RMC Powertome XL microtome for sectioning specimens for electron microscopy. Thick/thin sectioning from 20-999 nm. Cryostage -120 °C to RT. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: MJB3 Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: Broadband MUV contact lithography tool reproducing linewidths down to 1um on substrates up to 3 inch. Single field alignment microscope. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: MPT Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA tool processing up to 4” wafers. Atmospheres: N2, O2. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: MTI LPCVD Furnace
equipment.specifications: LPCVD system configured for graphene growth. Supply gases: methane, argon, nitrogen, hydrogen. Base vacuum <100mT, max temp 1100C. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Nanoindenter
equipment.specifications: Hysitron TI900 Triboindenter automated high-throughput system for nanomechanical characterization. Category: Mechanical Testing.

equipment.name: Nikon Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical microscope with video capture capability. Brightfield and darkfield modes with 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, and 100x magnification lenses. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: OAI Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: Broadband mid-UV exposure tool for samples up to 8” wafers. Dual optic alignment system (~1um frontside overlay, ~20um backside overlay). Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Ocean Optics Optical Spectrometer
equipment.specifications: USB4000-UV-VIS miniature spectrometer for UV-Vis measurements from 200-850 nm including absorption, transmission, reflectance, and emission. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Olympus Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical white light microscope with objective magnifications of 5x, 20x, 50x, and 100x. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Oxford Aztec EDS and EBSD System
equipment.specifications: Peltier cooled SDD x-ray detector (80mm2) with high count rate. High sensitivity EBSD camera with 4-channel fore scattering detector system. Category: Diffraction.

equipment.name: Oxford INCA EDS
equipment.specifications: 10mm2 detector with 140eV resolution for elemental analysis, mapping, line scans, and point/area analysis. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Parylene Coater
equipment.specifications: Deposits conformal polymeric coating on exposed surfaces with thickness controlled from nanometers to multiple microns. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Photoresist Solvent Strip
equipment.specifications: Uses NMP based organic solvent to dissolve photoresists. Incompatible with copper and SU-8. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: PicoSun Atomic Layer Deposition
equipment.specifications: Thermal and plasma enhanced ALD system accepting up to 8” wafers, max temp 400C. Configured for 5 precursor reagents and 3 plasma gases (N2, H2, O2). Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm PECVD
equipment.specifications: One chamber dedicated to PECVD processing (SiO2 at 300C, SiN at 250C). Accommodates samples up to 8” diameter. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm RIE
equipment.specifications: One chamber dedicated to RIE processing using fluorinated chemistries (SF6, CHF3, CF4) for samples up to 8” diameter. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: PlasMod O2 Asher
equipment.specifications: Compact oxygen plasma asher processing up to 4” diameter samples for resist stripping, organic cleaning, and surface modification. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: RCA Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: Dedicated to CMOS compatible substrates up to 8” wafers for RCA chemistries. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: Rigaku XtaLAB SynergyS Dual Source Single Crystal Diffractometer
equipment.specifications: Single crystal diffractometer featuring rotating anode with dual wavelength (Mo and Cu), HyPix-6000HE Detector, and Oxford Cryosystems Cryostream 800 low temperature system (100K). Category: Diffraction.

equipment.name: SemiTool Spin Rinse Dry
equipment.specifications: Sprays DI water through dedicated rinse manifold and purges using heated N2. Accepts round wafers (3”, 4”, 6”, 8”). Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Solvent Fume Hood
equipment.specifications: General purpose solvent fume hood. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Suss Manual 4 Probe Station
equipment.specifications: Electrical test of up to 8” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators, heated stage, microscope video system, and test meters. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Suss PSM6 Probe Manual Station
equipment.specifications: Electrical test of up to 6” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators and heated stage, configured for use with Keithley 4200. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (1)
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped high vacuum PVD thin film system (electron beam and thermal evaporation). Planetary accommodates up to 8” samples. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (2)
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped high vacuum PVD thin film electron beam evaporator. Planetary accommodates up to 8” samples. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Tencor Flexus Stress Measurement
equipment.specifications: Measures change in radius of curvature of wafer caused by thin film deposition to calculate stress and CTE. Wafers from 3” to 8”. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Thermocarbo Dicing Saw
equipment.specifications: TCAR 864 diamond bladed programmable dicing saw for sample sizes up to 6” wafers. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Tousimis Critical Point Dryer
equipment.specifications: Critical point dryer used to dry samples, reduce air drying damage, and release MEMS devices. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Trion RIE
equipment.specifications: ICP-RIE system with fluorinated and chlorinated chemistries for semiconductor, compound semiconductor, and metal plasma etching. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 1
equipment.specifications: Thermo Scientific Genesys 10 UV-Vis spectrophotometer operating from 325 – 1100 nm with 1.0 nm accuracy. Transmittance 0.3 to 125%, absorbance -0.1 to 3.0. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 2
equipment.specifications: Perkin Elmer Lambda 950 UV-Vis-NIR spectrophotometer, wavelength range 175 – 3300 nm, resolution <0.05nm. Double beam, double monochromator, ratio recording with Photomultiplier R6872 detector. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Vacuum Bake Oven
equipment.specifications: Small oven reaching ~150C at 22 inHg vacuum. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Veeco Dimension 3100 AFM
equipment.specifications: D-3100 AFM with large sub-stage for 6 inch wafers. Supports tapping, contact, CAFM, TUNA, MFM, wet cell imaging, and STM modes. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscope
equipment.specifications: XPS system for surface chemistry at sub-10 nm scale. Spatial resolution ~10 mm, spectral resolution <0.5 eV. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: YES Vacuum Oven
equipment.specifications: Convective vacuum oven accommodating up to 8” wafers, vacuum level ~500mT, temperature up to 170C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Zeiss Supra Nabity E-beam
equipment.specifications: Zeiss SUPRA 55 FESEM equipped with Nabity control system for e-beam lithography. Reads CAD, DFX, GDSII formats; 20nm-50nm feature sizes. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Zyvex Nanoprobe System
equipment.specifications: 4 point probe system for near nano-scale test probing. Paired with Keithley Analyzers. Staff operated only. Category: Electrical Testing.
